prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Test Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Try hiding, calling, and moving your pet using system tray controls before entering your desktop.", "Test System Tray Controls"]
1: ["Initializing Desktop Engine", "Verifying screen overlay support, rendering pipeline, and background pet companion service.", "Desktop overlay rendering engine verified active"]
2: ["Choose & Preview Your Desktop Pet", "Test desktop movement animations and sound effects before finalizing your adoption choice.", "Play Pet Call Sound", "Preview Desktop Animation"]
3: ["Select Your Pet Experience Path", "Choose between pre-made pet companion adoption or custom photo generation."]
4: ["Signing in automatically syncs and preserves your existing adopted pets and saved progress."]
5: ["Preparing desktop graphics engine. Setup typically completes within 3 minutes."]
6: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Your pet is now active on screen! Right-click the system tray icon or press Ctrl+Shift+P to open quick pet controls anytime."]
7: ["Use well-lit, front-facing photos for optimal 3D desktop pet rendering"]
8: ["Desktop pet engine pre-loading active"]
9: []
